title: Jais 2：阿拉伯语中心的开源大语言模型系列
summary: Jais 2 是由MBZUAI、Cerebras和Inception联合开发的阿拉伯语中心大语言模型系列，包含70B参数的最大开源阿拉伯语模型及8B变体。采用定制阿拉伯语词汇表和优化架构，实现高效训练与推理。在阿拉伯语及文化基准上表现优异，同时具备竞争力英语能力。模型以商业许可开源，70B版本支持高速聊天应用。
summary_en: Jais 2 is a family of Arabic-centric LLMs by MBZUAI, Cerebras, and Inception, featuring the largest open Arabic-centric model at 70B parameters and an 8B variant. With custom Arabic vocabulary and optimized architecture, it achieves strong Arabic and competitive English performance, released under a permissive license.
